Buyer questions

Ordering essentials.

Buying guides
What is the minimum wholesale order?

The published minimum is 5,000 bags. Its application across designs, sizes and colors is confirmed with your quote.

Can I add my own logo?

Yes. Tell us about your logo and printing requirements when requesting a quote. Our team will confirm artwork, colors and placement with you before production.

How long does production take?

Timing is confirmed with your quotation.

Can I request samples first?

Yes. Samples have a separate inquiry route. Availability, sample costs and shipping terms require confirmation.
